title: Headings Practice 7: Economics and Work
topic: Money, business and the world of work

questions.prompt: Choose the best heading for this paragraph. (Paragraph 1)
questions.context: Barter requires a double coincidence of wants: you must find someone who has what you need and also needs what you have. Money removes this obstacle by acting as a medium of exchange, a store of value and a unit of account. Societies have used shells, salt, metal discs and, more recently, electronic entries, provided that people trust that others will accept them in return.
options: Why money makes exchange easier than barter
The history of coins and metals
questions.answer: Why money makes exchange easier than barter
questions.why: Ý chính: tiền giải quyết hạn chế của hàng đổi hàng. Muối, vỏ sò chỉ là ví dụ.

questions.prompt: Choose the best heading for this paragraph. (Paragraph 2)
questions.context: Supermarkets arrange their stores to encourage extra purchases. Essential items such as milk and bread are placed at the back so that shoppers walk past tempting displays; sweets sit near the checkout where tired children make requests; and the most expensive products are placed at eye level. Researchers estimate that such layout decisions can raise sales by several per cent.
options: The price of milk and bread
The rise of online grocery shopping
Store layouts designed to influence what shoppers buy
questions.answer: Store layouts designed to influence what shoppers buy
questions.why: Đoạn nói bố cục siêu thị nhằm tác động mua sắm. Các lựa chọn khác chỉ là chi tiết.

questions.prompt: Choose the best heading for this paragraph. (Paragraph 3)
questions.context: The gig economy offers flexibility: workers choose when to drive, deliver or complete small tasks through an app. But the arrangement often brings insecurity. Workers are usually classed as self-employed, so they may lack sick pay, holiday pay and a guaranteed minimum income. Courts in several countries have ruled that some platform workers should be treated as employees, and companies are appealing the decisions.
options: The flexibility and insecurity of app-based work
questions.answer: The flexibility and insecurity of app-based work
questions.why: Trọng tâm: tính linh hoạt đi kèm bất ổn của công việc qua ứng dụng. Phán quyết toà án chỉ là một phần.

questions.prompt: Choose the best heading for this paragraph. (Paragraph 4)
questions.context: In 1637, tulip bulbs in the Netherlands reached prices equal to the cost of a fine house, then collapsed within weeks. Tulip mania is often cited as the first speculative bubble. Some modern historians argue that the story has been exaggerated, since few people were ruined and records are scanty, but it remains a popular warning about prices that rise because buyers expect others to pay more.
options: The cultivation of tulips in Holland
The cost of houses in the seventeenth century
A famous bubble and the doubts about the story
questions.answer: A famous bubble and the doubts about the story
questions.why: Ý chính: bong bóng hoa tulip nổi tiếng nhưng câu chuyện có thể bị phóng đại. Giá nhà chỉ là so sánh.

questions.prompt: Choose the best heading for this paragraph. (Paragraph 5)
questions.context: Comparative advantage explains why trade benefits both sides even when one country is better at producing everything. If a country is relatively more efficient at making wine than cloth, it gains by specialising in wine and importing cloth, leaving the other country to focus on cloth. Both end up with more of both goods than if each tried to make everything itself.
options: How specialisation allows all trading partners to gain
questions.answer: How specialisation allows all trading partners to gain
questions.why: Trọng tâm: lợi thế so sánh giúp mọi bên cùng có lợi. Rượu vang và vải chỉ là minh hoạ.

questions.prompt: Choose the best heading for this paragraph. (Paragraph 6)
questions.context: Interns are often unpaid, particularly in creative industries and politics, and critics argue that this favours young people whose families can support them. Those without such help may not be able to accept opportunities that could lead to a career. A few countries have introduced laws requiring pay for internships beyond a short period, though enforcement is uneven.
options: Unpaid internships and the fairness of access to careers
The cost of living for students
questions.answer: Unpaid internships and the fairness of access to careers
questions.why: Ý chính: thực tập không lương gây bất công về cơ hội. Luật trả lương chỉ là phản ứng.
questions.quote: favours young people whose families can support them

questions.prompt: Choose the best heading for this paragraph. (Paragraph 7)
questions.context: Economists measure unemployment as the share of people without work who are actively seeking it. The figure can mislead. People who have given up looking are not counted, and those working a few hours a week are classed as employed. Some governments therefore publish broader measures that include discouraged workers and part-timers who would like more hours.
options: Why headline unemployment figures can be misleading
questions.answer: Why headline unemployment figures can be misleading
questions.why: Trọng tâm: con số thất nghiệp có thể gây hiểu lầm. Các lựa chọn khác chỉ nắm một ý.

questions.prompt: Choose the best heading for this paragraph. (Paragraph 8)
questions.context: Franchises allow a business owner to sell the right to use a brand and system to local operators. The franchisee pays fees and follows set rules, gaining a recognised name and support, while the franchiser expands without investing in every outlet. Problems arise when the two sides disagree about fees, supplies or the right to open nearby competing branches.
options: How the franchise model works and where it causes conflict
questions.answer: How the franchise model works and where it causes conflict
questions.why: Đoạn giải thích mô hình nhượng quyền và xung đột. Từng lựa chọn khác quá hẹp.
questions.quote: gaining a recognised name and support

questions.prompt: Choose the best heading for this paragraph. (Paragraph 9)
questions.context: Microchips are made in a few factories, mostly in East Asia, which creates a fragile supply chain. When demand surged and some plants closed temporarily in 2020 and 2021, car makers around the world had to cut production because a handful of cheap components were missing. Governments are now offering subsidies to build factories closer to home.
options: Dependence on a few producers and government responses
questions.answer: Dependence on a few producers and government responses
questions.why: Ý chính: chuỗi cung ứng mong manh vì phụ thuộc vào ít nhà máy. Ô tô chỉ là một ví dụ.

questions.prompt: Choose the best heading for this paragraph. (Paragraph 10)
questions.context: A four-day working week has been trialled in several countries. In many trials, employees were paid the same for fewer hours, and most firms reported unchanged or higher productivity, along with lower burnout and fewer resignations. However, participants tend to be small, office-based businesses that volunteered, so it is unclear whether the results would apply to hospitals, factories or shops.
options: Positive trial results for shorter weeks, with limits
questions.answer: Positive trial results for shorter weeks, with limits
questions.why: Đoạn nói kết quả thử nghiệm tích cực nhưng giới hạn khả năng áp dụng. Burnout chỉ là một kết quả.
questions.quote: unclear whether the results would apply

questions.prompt: Choose the best heading for this paragraph. (Paragraph 11)
questions.context: Advertising seeks not only to inform but to create associations. A drink is shown with laughing friends, a car with open roads, a bank with security. Psychologists say that repeated exposure builds familiarity, which people mistake for quality. Because consumers often cannot recall seeing individual advertisements, the influence is largely unconscious.
options: How advertising shapes preferences without conscious attention
questions.answer: How advertising shapes preferences without conscious attention
questions.why: Ý chính: quảng cáo tác động vô thức qua liên tưởng. Xe, ngân hàng chỉ là ví dụ.

questions.prompt: Choose the best heading for this paragraph. (Paragraph 12)
questions.context: Cash is declining in many countries as people switch to cards and phone payments. Sweden is the clearest example, where small shops and even churches accept electronic donations. Yet critics warn that a cashless society excludes people without bank accounts, creates risks if networks fail, and leaves users' spending habits visible to companies and governments.
options: Risks of moving away from cash
questions.answer: Risks of moving away from cash
questions.why: Trọng tâm: rủi ro của xã hội không tiền mặt. Thụy Điển chỉ là ví dụ minh hoạ xu hướng.

questions.prompt: Choose the best heading for this paragraph. (Paragraph 13)
questions.context: Cooperatives are businesses owned and run by their members, who may be farmers, workers or customers. Profits are shared according to participation rather than investment. The Mondragon group in Spain employs tens of thousands of people in a federation of cooperatives, and surveys suggest its workers enjoy greater job security than average, although decision-making can be slow.
options: Spanish industry in the twentieth century
Member-owned businesses and the example of Mondragon
questions.answer: Member-owned businesses and the example of Mondragon
questions.why: Ý chính: hợp tác xã do thành viên sở hữu, ví dụ Mondragon. Việc ra quyết định chậm chỉ là điểm yếu nhỏ.
questions.quote: owned and run by their members

questions.prompt: Choose the best heading for this paragraph. (Paragraph 14)
questions.context: Inheritance shapes inequality. Wealthy families pass on money, property and social contacts, giving children a head start. Some economists propose higher taxes on large inheritances to level the playing field; others respond that people have a right to leave their money to whom they choose, and that heavy taxes encourage the rich to hide assets abroad.
options: The argument over taxing inherited wealth
How families pass on social contacts
questions.answer: The argument over taxing inherited wealth
questions.why: Trọng tâm: tranh luận về đánh thuế thừa kế. Giấu tài sản chỉ là luận điểm phản đối.

questions.prompt: Choose the best heading for this paragraph. (Paragraph 15)
questions.context: Seasonal tourism can strain small communities. In peak months, rents rise, roads clog and local services struggle, while in winter many businesses close and workers lose income. Some destinations now promote off-season visits through discounts and events, hoping to spread demand more evenly throughout the year. Local councils have also experimented with small tourist taxes to pay for services.
options: Uneven tourist demand and attempts to balance it
questions.answer: Uneven tourist demand and attempts to balance it
questions.why: Ý chính: du lịch theo mùa gây áp lực và nỗ lực cân bằng. Giá thuê nhà chỉ là một ảnh hưởng.

questions.prompt: Choose the best heading for this paragraph. (Paragraph 16)
questions.context: Women are underrepresented in senior business roles in most countries. Explanations include career breaks for childcare, differences in networks and bias in promotion decisions. Some companies have tried transparent pay scales and blind recruitment, in which names are hidden from application forms, and report modest gains, though researchers say lasting change requires altering workplace culture.
options: Attempts to address the shortage of women in senior jobs
questions.answer: Attempts to address the shortage of women in senior jobs
questions.why: Đoạn nói nguyên nhân và các nỗ lực khắc phục. Ẩn tên chỉ là một biện pháp.

questions.prompt: Choose the best heading for this paragraph. (Paragraph 17)
questions.context: Auctions are used to sell everything from artwork to radio spectrum. In an English auction, bidders raise their offers openly until one remains. In a sealed-bid auction, each submits one secret offer. Economists study these formats because they influence prices; a poorly designed auction can leave the seller with far less than the goods are worth, as some national spectrum sales have shown.
options: Different auction formats and why design matters
questions.answer: Different auction formats and why design matters
questions.why: Ý chính: các hình thức đấu giá và tầm quan trọng của thiết kế. Phổ tần chỉ là ví dụ.

questions.prompt: Choose the best heading for this paragraph. (Paragraph 18)
questions.context: Minimum wage laws raise pay for the lowest earners, but economists have long debated their side effects. A simple model predicts that higher wages reduce the number of jobs. Yet several empirical studies in the 1990s found little loss of employment after modest increases, suggesting that employers may absorb costs through small price rises or lower turnover.
options: Evidence that minimum wage rises may not cost jobs
questions.answer: Evidence that minimum wage rises may not cost jobs
questions.why: Trọng tâm: bằng chứng cho thấy tăng lương tối thiểu có thể không mất việc. Mô hình đơn giản là quan điểm đối lập.

questions.prompt: Choose the best heading for this paragraph. (Paragraph 19)
questions.context: Craft guilds in medieval towns controlled who could practise a trade. Members paid fees, followed standards and trained apprentices who worked for years before becoming masters. The system protected quality and prices, but it also limited competition and excluded outsiders. Many economists believe that its decline in the eighteenth century cleared the way for new industries and techniques.
options: The benefits and drawbacks of medieval trade guilds
questions.answer: The benefits and drawbacks of medieval trade guilds
questions.why: Đoạn cân nhắc cả ưu và nhược điểm của phường hội. Học nghề chỉ là chi tiết.

questions.prompt: Choose the best heading for this paragraph. (Paragraph 20)
questions.context: Supply and demand explain why prices change. When more people want a product than there is available, sellers can raise prices; when stock exceeds demand, they cut them. Umbrella sellers know this well: a sudden shower will raise the price at a street stall within minutes. In practice, markets are shaped by other forces, such as taxes, regulation and the power of large firms, so prices do not always settle where simple models predict.
options: How supply and demand set prices, and where the model falls short
questions.answer: How supply and demand set prices, and where the model falls short
questions.why: Ý chính: cung cầu quyết định giá nhưng mô hình có giới hạn. Bán ô là ví dụ.
questions.quote: markets are shaped by other forces
